steps.title: Heat reaches the land
steps.text: A hot spell arrives at the worst moment of the growing season.

steps.title: Soils dry, harvests fail
steps.text: Moisture is pulled from the ground just when crops need it most.

steps.title: The shock travels to the market
steps.text: Smaller harvests mean higher prices, felt by families far from the field.

steps.title: Children eat less, and learn less
steps.text: Hungry children struggle in class, and the loss follows them for life.

steps.title: Stopping work becomes impossible
steps.text: With food costing more, there is even less room to rest during the heat.

steps.title: And some don’t survive
steps.text: Working through the hottest hours, without rest, water or shade, can kill. From a dry field to a death that may never be counted as heat.
